items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was very close with Gil Evans. I would see him almost everyday.

ctx.x: When we were talking about the other projects and other collaborations you were doing in ‘59 we didn’t mention a couple of landmark recordings, one being “Sketches Of Spain.” How did that come about, your participation in “Sketches of Spain”?
I was very close with Gil Evans. I would see him almost everyday.
Where? Where did you see him?
